newsitem.title: USA: Carmike, other stocks seen 'pricey' - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Carmike, other stocks seen 'pricey' - Barron's.

text.p: Theater stocks such as Carmike Cinemas Inc and others may be "pricey", Barron's reported in its latest edition, citing PaineWebber analyst Christopher Dixon.
Carmike, AMC Entertainment Inc and Regal Cinemas Inc topped an average 8.1 percent times cash flow, prompting Dixon to lower his rating on the theater group to neutral, according to Barron's.
"These were great stocks in the first half of the year, but there's a lot of uncertainity in the next three to six months," Barron's quoted Dixon as saying.
Dixon and other analysts are concerned that theater stocks' second-quarter profits will be lower-than-expected, the magazine said in the article apearing in its latest edition.
